matter_background.original: Sarth Perera of No.14, Saranankara Mawatha, Dehiwala gives you a copy of his Last Will bearing No.3250 dated 8th August 2009 attested by Peter Perera Notary Public and states that he wants to change clause 5 in the Last Will such that he would give his House and property called Malwatta at Moratuwa to his Daughter Himali and his house at No.14, Dammadara Mawatha, Ratmalana to his son Hemal both subject to life interest of his wife Kumudu. He also wishes to add to the Last Will a clause thereby that he would give Rs.250, 000/- in cash to his driver Bandula and a sum of Rs.50, 000/- to his servant Karunadasa. All other clauses in the Last Will would remain unchanged.
